collection.title: Toyota Avensis Hatchback 2008 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Toyota Avensis Hatchback Mk3 2008 Onwards will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Avensis which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.

image.alt: Toyota Avensis Hatchback 2008 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
